cases.study_information: Ten measured affinity-matured/framework-modified antibody clones from a single anti-IL17A/F campaign. Columns describe the same named source clones across source Tables4,5,7,9. This is a transfer-from-measured-assays task, not inference from unprovided sequences. SPR: captured antibody, soluble human cytokine, 25C, source neutral pH7.4 normalized to benchmark pH7.5. NFkB: HEK293 IL17RA+/IL17RC+ luciferase reporter, cytokine/antibody preassociation1h, cells16h. NHDF: normal human dermal fibroblasts, 0.5ng/mL TNF, cytokine/antibody preassociation1h, cells16h, supernatantIL6 ELISA. Reported ties are retained; source precision and finite sample uncertainty limit interpretation of near ties. No target relative IC50 or direct derived target is supplied.

dependence_note: Shared sources must be interpreted at the study-family level.
title: Transferring IL17A reporter inhibition to primary fibroblast cytokine release
